title: Your main ingredient costs 40% more
body: The price of your main ingredient or raw material has risen 40% and will stay there for six months. Your price on the pack cannot change overnight.

title: Your packaging is banned
body: The state government bans the plastic packaging you use, starting in 60 days. Shops will not accept old packs after that.

title: A big brand copies you
body: A large national brand launches a near-identical product at a 20% lower price, with heavy advertising and better shelf space.

title: Your only factory shuts
body: A fire shuts the only factory that makes your product for eight weeks. Shops start running out of stock this week.

title: A batch fails a safety test
body: One batch fails a food or product safety test. You must recall it from shops, and the news is spreading on social media.

title: Your biggest shop drops you
body: The supermarket chain that sells 30% of your packs stops stocking you after a dispute over margins.

title: Tax on your category rises
body: The GST on your product category rises from 12% to 18% from next month. Shops will not take a lower margin.

title: A viral post says your product is unhealthy
body: A widely shared video claims your product is unhealthy. Sales fall 30% in a week, even though the claim is not true.

title: A transport strike doubles delivery costs
body: A truckers' strike doubles your delivery costs for the next three months and delays deliveries to small towns.

title: Your packaging supplier quits
body: Your only packaging supplier goes out of business. A new supplier needs a 10,000-pack minimum order and four weeks to start.
